caller_asset_contract.notes: Every source, MATLAB, LTFAT and CVX path, toolbox version, install location, experiment config, licence, rights record, documented tool use, cohort manifest, parity vector and output-use grant must exist at an absolute path and match its declared SHA-256 or revision before a caller may process audio. No upstream revision is pinned because the merged evidence records only project and repository URLs; a shape-valid manifest cannot manufacture qualification.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply the exact declipping2020_codes source checkout at an immutable 40-hex revision under data/checkouts/declipping2020_codes or a recorded alias; no checkout exists in the workspace.

Resolve https://github.com/rajmic/declipping2020_codes to a full 40-hex commit and publish its per-file SHA-256 manifest plus the toolbox release version; the merged evidence records only project and repository URLs.

Provide one licensed MATLAB installation (proprietary, licensed product) with exact release/update identifier, recorded platform and install location, and an environment manifest at data/envs/matlab-ltfat-cvx/environment.json; no MATLAB installation is present.
Provide LTFAT at an exact 40-hex revision with a per-file SHA-256 manifest at data/toolboxes/ltfat/manifest.json and its licence terms; no LTFAT checkout is present and no revision is recorded.

Provide the optional CVX solver path at an exact 40-hex revision with a per-file SHA-256 manifest at data/toolboxes/cvx/manifest.json for the C-OMP comparison, or record an approved alternative; no CVX checkout is present and no revision is recorded.

Record one documented typical tool use: exact invocation, dictionary/frame, window and hop, block length, clipping threshold and mask policy, sparsity or target cardinality, stopping tolerance, iteration cap, regularization and expected numeric output. The merged research document reports only that the authors' toolbox needs MATLAB, LTFAT and CVX and was not runnable in the Python pilot.

Add the declipping2020_codes licence and terms at the resolved commit, the MATLAB licence basis and activation constraints, the LTFAT and CVX licence terms, and source-audio, clean-reference and redistribution/product-use rights with notices; no licence file, terms statement, grant or rights record exists.

Produce one approved exact-runtime output from an isolated, licensed environment, a frozen parity vector at data/runs/matlab-ltfat-cvx-tools-parity/manifest.json, and separated compile/build, synthetic runtime and measured workload evidence; no adapter prototype, output, parity vector or timing result exists.

external_adapter_boundary.adapter_prototype_condition: only if an approved public or user-supplied MATLAB/LTFAT/CVX runtime is supplied at exact pins; no such runtime is present
external_adapter_boundary.disclosure_without_licensed_runtime: report the absent MATLAB/LTFAT/CVX runtime and the resulting blocker; never present a sibling control as the toolbox method
external_adapter_boundary.fallback_without_licensed_runtime: the merged sibling synthetic controls remain the only available evidence, and they do not reproduce or approximate the toolbox
external_adapter_boundary.notes: The vendor boundary is documented, not bridged. MATLAB is a proprietary licensed product; LTFAT and the optional CVX path are caller-supplied dependencies. Nothing is downloaded, vendored, registered or invoked, and no adapter JSON is added.

gates.requirement: The full 40-hex toolbox/LTFAT/CVX revisions, MATLAB release identity, toolbox version, install location, experiment config and metadata SHA-256 values and the source licence match exact pins.
An isolated, licensed MATLAB runtime plus LTFAT and the optional CVX path with a complete environment manifest is admitted on a recorded platform.
Toolbox, MATLAB, LTFAT, CVX, source-audio, clean-reference, output-use and redistribution rights are cleared with notices.
A clean checkout or extracted package is verified and one documented typical CLI/API use produces a reproducible numeric result.
Caller-owned inputs are validated and malformed inputs plus missing optional selections are rejected before processing.
Allowed access, exact candidate data, local runtime versus vendor-output scoring versus vendor claim, fallback and disclosure without a licensed runtime are documented and approved.
Explicit opt-in adapter intake, licence review and an independent public-surface decision are complete; the component remains optional.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

qualification.reason: The exact declipping2020_codes source checkout, full upstream revision, licensed MATLAB/LTFAT/CVX runtime, documented typical tool use, task geometry and hash-pinned environment are absent; no licence, rights record, rights-cleared clipped/clean cohort, clean reference, isolated adapter, parity vector or local toolbox output exists.

cvx.role: optional convex solver path for the C-OMP comparison

matlab.role: proprietary licensed MATLAB runtime for the toolbox

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the tool acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. Verify vendor terms and clean integration before any distribution; keep source-reported scores labeled.
stable_fields.deliverable: Document the vendor boundary. Prototype an isolated adapter only if an approved public or user-supplied runtime is available. Document MATLAB/LTFAT dependencies and optional CVX path for the C-OMP comparison.
stable_fields.title: MATLAB/LTFAT/CVX sparse declipping tools
write_scope: SDK provider, tool or evidence directory for matlab-ltfat-cvx-sparse-declipping-tools and its own fixtures

tool_profile_requirements.requirement: Record the tool version, exact install location and upstream provenance with a pinned revision and per-file digest.
Verify a clean checkout or extracted package, including the MATLAB, LTFAT and optional CVX dependencies.
Run one typical documented CLI/API use and record its exact output.
Accept caller-owned inputs only after absolute-path, digest, revision and geometry validation.
Reject malformed, nonfinite, duplicate-key and out-of-range inputs before use.
Handle missing optional selections explicitly, including an absent CVX path, without silently substituting a different method.
Separate compile/build evidence, synthetic runtime evidence and measured workload support as distinct outcomes.
